reviewer: Agent visual and ordinary-input task review; no human novice study

clarity.notes: Actual edge/text hit targets expose the relevant cursor without adding instructions or a mode switch.

convenience.notes: Resize and Escape restore exact bounds; one click still selects and ordinary caption/menu/keyboard actions remain available.

friendliness.notes: Pointer movement does not launch an app, select a file or destroy dirty documents; owner-bound movement/cancel tasks are separately tested.

graphics.notes: Original antialiased geometric cursor outlines retain centered hotspots at supported scales, with no bitmap stretching; compact/150%/physical-4K frames are actual native captures.

readability.notes: Reviewed Files/Start and cursor captures retain smooth type, readable controls and no essential overlap. Existing high-contrast boundary refinements remain M13.11.

limits: Visual/scoped functional review only; not duration or stability qualification
Native processing completion and external scanout remain different measurements
Full integration and subsequent final stability remain M13.12 and M13.13 respectively
